faqs.title: FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS – SMP FOR SCARS (SCALP MICROPIGMENTATION)

list.q: Can SMP for scars completely hide a hair transplant scar?
list.a: Visually yes – scalp micropigmentation (hair tattoo) conceals the color and contrast difference. Physically, the scar remains.

list.q: Does SMP treatment irritate the scar after FUE/FUT transplant?
list.a: No. Scalp micropigmentation uses a sterile technique with gentle pressure. SMP for scars is safe and painless.

list.q: How long does the effect of SMP for scars last?
list.a: 2–4 years, after which a pigment refresh (hair tattoo touch-up) can be performed.

list.q: Is SMP treatment possible for multiple scars after hair transplant?
list.a: Yes – each case of FUE/FUT transplant scars is assessed individually for scalp micropigmentation.
